chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) who said:

Gabriel (peace be upon him) came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said: 'Adhere to the Barni dates, for they are the best of your dates. They bring you closer to Allah, the Exalted, and distance you from the Fire.'

key_terms.البَرْنِيِّ: A specific variety of high-quality dates

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of eating Barni dates according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Gabriel (a.s.) specifically recommends Barni dates for their dual capacity to bring one closer to Allah and distance one from Hellfire, a concept deeply rooted in Shia hadith literature regarding the spiritual merit of specific foods. This narration underscores the Shi'a belief in the tangible spiritual benefits (*thawab*) of consuming prophetic foods, linking physical sustenance directly to eschatological reward.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-135 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, “

Gabriel (a.s.) descended to the Prophet (S) and said, I advise you to eat ‘barni’ dates as they are the best type of your dates. That will help you get closer to the Honorable the Exalted God and get more distant from the Fire.”
